QuestionStmt.S: Three concentric charged metallic spherical sheets A, B and C have radii a, b, c potentials $V_A$, $V_B$, $V_C$ and charge densities $+\sigma$, $-\sigma$ and $+\sigma$ respectively. The value of potential $V_A$ is ($\varepsilon_0 =$ permittivity of free space)

Solution.S:
Potential at A is the sum of potentials due to all shells at radius a.

Potential due to shell A on itself:
$$V_{A \to A} = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} \frac{Q_A}{a} = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} \frac{4\pi a^2 \sigma}{a} = \frac{a\sigma}{\varepsilon_0}$$

Potential at A due to shell B (radius b, charge density $-\sigma$):
$$V_{B \to A} = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} \frac{Q_B}{b} = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} \frac{4\pi b^2 (-\sigma)}{b} = -\frac{b\sigma}{\varepsilon_0}$$

Potential at A due to shell C (radius c, charge density $+\sigma$):
$$V_{C \to A} = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} \frac{Q_C}{c} = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} \frac{4\pi c^2 \sigma}{c} = \frac{c\sigma}{\varepsilon_0}$$

Therefore,
$$V_A = \frac{a\sigma}{\varepsilon_0} - \frac{b\sigma}{\varepsilon_0} + \frac{c\sigma}{\varepsilon_0} = \frac{\sigma}{\varepsilon_0}(a - b + c)$$

Thus the correct option is C.
